column1: # Pokémon Violet 1.0.0, Game Freak's Trinity engine, SDK 13.3.5.
# Pokémon Scarlet's twin (0100A3D008C5C000): the same sdk and subsdk0 builds, only main is its own.
# Made from Scarlet's profile with Violet's title, name, IPA name, build row and shader tables.
# Only 1.0.0 is registered; use -p v0 when the NSP folder also has updates.
# The 3D layout exposes the right stick for the camera and the D-pad.
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near=0); prepare the same main0_z bases
# offline so the first run can use them instead of repeating the full prebuild.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie; the host supplies its imported entry points.
# The host's StandardAllocator cap, the 62 MB SDK node area and the SDK-wide
# region alignment fit in the alias region. See Scarlet's README.md for the startup probes.
# Startup allocates and frees everything allocatable. The SDK releases those
# cached pages only after a map fails at the real application-pool limit.
